title: DAG-Math: Graph-of-Thought Guided Mathematical Reasoning in LLMs

scope.included: 固定模型数学DAG格式CoT的答案正确率与逻辑闭合PRR比较，含同题32/128次轨迹。
scope.excluded: 不把报告的图结构等同真实内部思维或每步数学验证。
scope.study_summary: 正式ICLR论文用固定LLM的结构化CoT实际输出，对比只看最终答案与要求逻辑闭合的推理计分，分析错误轨迹的分支/依赖结构；有明确推理构念和测量有效性研究对象，非仅通用正确率排行。所选实验通过提示完成，无新参数训练。
scope.scope_basis: 冻结交付的最终reason/review及qualification_scope；候选字段仅作定位，事实定向核原文

reading.limits: 逐篇核查已纳入研究单元及其直接支撑方法，引用段落实际读取；未声称全篇全部实验重新阅读或验收。

facts.description: 逻辑闭合定义为非终点节点都有后续依赖；终点答案正确且逻辑闭合时命名为perfect reasoning。

Definition 1 (Logical closeness and perfect reasoning). Under Assumption 1, consider an input
prompt xin and the DAG Ggen (xin ). For each node v ∈ Ggen (xin ), define its out-degree as
                                          
                 deg v | Ggen (xin ) := u ∈ Ggen (xin ) | (v → u) ∈ Egen (xin ) .

We say that Ggen (xin ) is logically closed if
                                                
                             deg v | Ggen (xin ) ≥ 1, ∀ v ∈ Vgen (xin ),
i.e., only the final nodes have no outgoing edges. Furthermore, if the sink node corresponds to the
correct answer, we call the associated CoT trajectory a case of perfect reasoning.

facts.description: 每题用4shot提示生成32条DAG格式轨迹，统计图级结构并按全部/错误/正确/正确且闭合划分。

evidence.quote:
Experimental Settings: For each model, we use a 4-shot prompting strategy to generate 32 DAG-
MATH formatted CoT trajectories per problem across all datasets. Next, we extract the correspond-
ing DAGs and evaluate the five graph-level statistics introduced in Section 4.2, as well as model
performance metrics (e.g., PASS@1 and R).   b The sampled DAGs are then partitioned into four
classes: All (no filtering), Incorrect (ending at an incorrect sink), Correct (ending at the correct
sink), and Perfect (logically closed and ending at the correct sink).

facts.description: 扩展每题128条轨迹并报告PASS@1与PRR差的95%区间。

evidence.quote:
Reasoning Gap: We expand evaluation sample size from 32 to 128 trajectories per problem and
calculate 95% confidence intervals for the gap between PASS@1 and PRR. The resulting intervals
were tight and consistently excluded zero (e.g., confirming a 36% gap for Gemini-2.5-Flash),
statistically demonstrating that the difference between finding the correct answer and generating a
perfectly valid derivation is significant and substantial across all tested models. More details are
presented in Appendix K.1.

demands.need: 将答案正确与输出依赖闭合分开定义和计分。

matches.reason: PASS@1、PRR及图结构统计是不同结果。
所谓完美推理被操作化为正确终点与节点被引用。
闭合条件不能替代逐步数学正确性或内部推理效度。

matches.function: 输出格式约束 / 结构化输出
matches.reason: 结构化DAG输出使依赖引用与闭合判定可解析。

demands.need: 保留4shot示例和同题多轨迹采样，理解差值区间的题目依赖。

matches.function: 少样本示例选择与排列偏差
matches.reason: 4shot示例实际用于结构化推理诱导。
轨迹嵌套在题目内，不能直接当独立题。
差值95%区间是统计推断；PRR是正确答案子集，差显著不验证构念。

limitations: 报告区间的题目聚类处理未充分说明；输出结构也受格式/指令遵从影响，不称纯推理能力。
